registration.title: Skill scores only where the position uses them
registration.what: A player is scored in a skill only if his position's mix gives it weight, and his score is a percentile among the players of positions that use it. Van Dijk's finishing and attackers' solidity are no longer scored. Only the skill scores change.
registration.why: The owner's look over the live site, 2026-10-22: Van Dijk 84 in finishing, and wingers and attacking midfielders 88 to 99 in solidity, skills their positions don't use, set against everyone.
registration.how: skill_scores in player_ratings.py, with the positions that use each skill taken from SKILL_MIX (experiments/skill_where/DESIGN.md).
registration.hypothesis: None to test: a change to what is shown. Every rank stays as it was.
registration.success_criteria: experiments/skill_where/report.py: every rank, season rank, position rank, projection and predicted XI identical, base against changed.

events.label: Listed players scored in solidity, before and after (the other skills follow their positions); every rank and predicted XI identical
events.meaningful: V. van Dijk no longer scored in finishing (was 88), M. Salah, B. Saka, C. Palmer, H. Kane and E. Haaland no longer in solidity (88 to 99). Top ten in solidity now centre-backs and holding midfielders; in finishing, strikers and wingers

events.reason: Owner's choice, 2026-10-22, from the look over the live site (T-061): score a skill only where the position uses it.

events.note: Released as registered, as MC-0036 on 2026-10-22.
